title: Stripe's payment form opens on the bank account
assertion: The Payment Element's options list `us_bank_account` first and `card` second, from the shared order; tabs with the first open; Apple Pay, Google Pay and Link off; its appearance comes from the brand's live tokens, Stripe's night theme under the dark ones; the start button reads "Add a bank account (ACH) or card" with nothing on file and "Replace with a bank account (ACH) or card" with a method on file; a confirmed setup shows the saved notice, and one waiting on micro-deposits shows the verification notice for Stripe's type (one deposit with a 6-digit code, or two amounts) with Stripe's link, each notice a status; a missing or non-https verification link is an error
noFileReason: The Payment Element’s options and the confirmation’s notices are built from values the test passes in memory; Stripe’s form never renders; no file.
